raw_segments.text: Mr. Pumblechook helped me to the liver wing and to the best slice of tongue, none of those
out of the way no thoroughfares of pork now, and took, comparatively speaking, no care
Ah, poultry, poultry, you little thought, said Mr. Pumblechook, apostrophizing the fowl
in the dish, when you was a young fledgling what was in store for you.
You little thought you was to be refreshment beneath this humble roof for one as, call
it a weakness, if you will, said Mr. Pumblechook, getting up again.
